import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Cell {
        int r, c, dis;
        Cell(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static Queue<Cell> bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    static char[] s = new char[20];

    static int n, n1, m, lim, pathLen, bottleneck, sink;
    static int[][] sourceNode = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] sinkNode = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] zDist = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] cap = new int[205][205];
    static int[][] flo = new int[205][205];
    static int[] pathNodes = new int[205];
    static int[] height = new int[205];
    static int[] heightCnt = new int[203];
    static boolean alive, found;
    static boolean[][] passable = new boolean[12][12];
    static boolean[][] passableCopy = new boolean[12][12];

    static void dfsAugment(int x, int limit) {
        if (x == sink) {
            bottleneck = limit;
            found = true;
            return;
        }
        int bestHeight = n + 2;
        for (int y = 0; y <= n + 1; ++y) {
            if (flo[x][y] < cap[x][y]) {
                bestHeight = Math.min(bestHeight, height[y]);
                if (height[x] == height[y] + 1) {
                    pathNodes[++pathLen] = y;
                    dfsAugment(y, Math.min(limit, cap[x][y] - flo[x][y]));
                    if ((!alive) || found)
                        return;
                    pathNodes[pathLen--] = 0;
                }
            }
            if (flo[y][x] > 0) {
                bestHeight = Math.min(bestHeight, height[y]);
                if (height[x] == height[y] + 1) {
                    pathNodes[++pathLen] = -y;
                    dfsAugment(y, Math.min(limit, flo[y][x]));
                    if ((!alive) || found)
                        return;
                    pathNodes[pathLen--] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (bestHeight + 1 != height[x]) {
            --heightCnt[height[x]];
            if (heightCnt[height[x]] == 0)
                alive = false;
            height[x] = bestHeight + 1;
            ++heightCnt[height[x]];
        }
    }

    static boolean tryAugment() {
        found = false;
        bottleneck = n1;
        pathLen = 0;
        pathNodes[0] = 0;
        dfsAugment(0, n1);
        return found;
    }

    static void improve() {
        for (int x = 1; x <= pathLen; ++x) {
            if (pathNodes[x] > 0)
                flo[Math.abs(pathNodes[x-1])][pathNodes[x]] += bottleneck;
            else
                flo[-pathNodes[x]][Math.abs(pathNodes[x-1])] -= bottleneck;
        }
    }

    static void readSrcGrid() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    Cell c = new Cell(i, j, 0);
                    bfsQueue.add(c);
                } else if (ch != 'Y') {
                    passable[i][j] = true;
                    zDist[i][j] = lim;
                    int k = ch - '0';
                    if (k > 0) {
                        sourceNode[i][j] = ++n;
                        cap[0][n] = k;
                        n1 += k;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // copy passable to passableCopy
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j)
                passableCopy[i][j] = passable[i][j];
    }

    static void readDstGrid() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (ch == 'Z' || ch == 'Y')
                    continue;
                int k = ch - '0';
                if (k > 0) {
                    sinkNode[i][j] = ++n;
                    cap[n][m * m + 1] = k;
                }
            }
        }
        if (n != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j)
                    if (sinkNode[i][j] > 0) {
                        int v = sinkNode[i][j];
                        cap[v][n + 1] = cap[v][m * m + 1];
                        cap[v][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
        }
        sink = n + 1;
    }

    static void computeZDist() {
        while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
            Cell cur = bfsQueue.poll();
            int i = cur.r, j = cur.c;
            zDist[i][j] = cur.dis;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int ni = i + dr[d], nj = j + dc[d];
                if (passable[ni][nj]) {
                    passable[ni][nj] = false;
                    Cell nxt = new Cell(ni, nj, cur.dis + 1);
                    bfsQueue.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void buildGraph() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (sourceNode[i][j] == 0)
                    continue;
                // copy passableCopy to passable
                for (int ii = 1; ii <= m; ++ii)
                    for (int jj = 1; jj <= m; ++jj)
                        passable[ii][jj] = passableCopy[ii][jj];
                passable[i][j] = false;
                Cell start = new Cell(i, j, 0);
                bfsQueue.add(start);
                while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
                    Cell cur = bfsQueue.poll();
                    int x = cur.r, y = cur.c;
                    if (sinkNode[x][y] > 0 && cur.dis <= zDist[x][y])
                        cap[sourceNode[i][j]][sinkNode[x][y]] = n1;
                    if (cur.dis + 1 > lim || cur.dis >= zDist[x][y])
                        continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int nx = x + dr[d], ny = y + dc[d];
                        if (passable[nx][ny]) {
                            passable[nx][ny] = false;
                            Cell nxt = new Cell(nx, ny, cur.dis + 1);
                            bfsQueue.add(nxt);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = sc.nextInt();
        lim = sc.nextInt();
        // arrays are zero-initialized in Java
        readSrcGrid();
        readDstGrid();
        computeZDist();
        buildGraph();

        heightCnt[0] = n + 2;
        alive = true;
        while (alive && height[0] <= n + 2)
            while (tryAugment())
                improve();

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            ans += flo[i][sink];
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
